description: This Java class defines an immutable placeholder implementation for connection IDs within the Eclipse Ditto project. It supports resolving placeholders for connection IDs, specifically the 'id' placeholder, and is part of the 'placeholders' package.

classes.name: ImmutableConnectionIdPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable singleton class that indicates support for the 'connection:id' placeholder and provides logic to resolve a connection ID based on the placeholder.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string 'connection' indicating the category of placeholder.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list containing the supported placeholder name, 'id'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the specified placeholder name is supported by this implementation.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder to an actual connection ID string if applicable; returns an Optional containing the ID if successful.
